# Choir Rehearsal

> Choir practice tracks and SATB learning tracks for voice-part rehearsal on your own WordPress site. Listen on a phone. Lite is free. Pro is €49 a year.

Choir Rehearsal is a choir rehearsal app for WordPress. It holds choir practice tracks for voice parts rehearsal on the choir’s own site: SATB learning tracks for soprano, alto, tenor, and bass, next to the PDF score. Singer listens on a phone. Voice Leader adds the songs. Lite is free. Pro is €49 a year.

## Who it is for

Choir singers and the people who run rehearsals. Inside WordPress the role names stay English: Singer, Voice Leader, Administrator, and Guest.

## Lite and Pro

- Lite: Free. Free from WordPress.org or GitHub Releases Up to 4 voice tracks per song PDF scores and sticky player Upload audio or link official YouTube per track Updates via WordPress.org (GitHub Releases remain an alternative)
- Pro — subscription: €49 / year. Install beside Lite (separate add-on) Unlimited voice tracks per song Microphone recording in the admin Play preview of voice tracks in the song editor Embedded PDF score in the song editor (swipe pages) Search songs by title PDF icon on songs that have a score attached 1 choir website From 0.5.0, WordPress updates Pro automatically while the license is active Priority email support
- Done-for-you setup: from €120. One-time setup on your WordPress site /rehearsal/ page created Singer and Voice Leader roles configured Voice Leader training (1 session) First year of Pro included

## Install

1. Install Lite from WordPress.org (search “Compath Choir Rehearsal”) or upload the zip from GitHub Releases.
2. In WordPress: Plugins → Add New → activate Compath Choir Rehearsal (Lite).
3. Pro customers: download choir-rehearsal-pro.zip from your shop.compath.ee account, upload it beside Lite (Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin), and activate it. Do not replace Lite.
4. Activate the license under Choir Rehearsal → Pro License. Paste the key from your shop account.
5. From Pro 0.5.0, updates install automatically in WordPress (Dashboard → Updates or Plugins) while the license is active. You can also enable auto-updates for the plugin.
6. If your Pro version is older than 0.5.0, download 0.5.0 from your shop account once and replace the plugin: deactivate and delete the old Pro, then upload the new zip, or use WordPress “Replace current with uploaded”. Activate the license. After that, no manual updates.
7. The plugin creates a /rehearsal/ page with the [choir_rehearsal] shortcode and WordPress roles Singer and Voice Leader (English names).
8. Add a song: Choir Rehearsal → Add Song — title, PDF, voice tracks (Audio or YouTube per track; needs Voice Leader or Administrator).
9. Assign Users → Singer for listening, Voice Leader for managing songs. Settings remain Administrator-only.

## FAQ

### Is Choir Rehearsal free?

Lite is free on WordPress.org. Pro is €49 per year for one choir website. A done-for-you setup starts at €120 and includes the first year of Pro.

### Does it work on phones?

Yes. Singer opens the choir site in the phone browser, signs in, and listens. There is no separate app to install.

### How does a singer get access?

An Administrator creates a WordPress user and assigns the Singer role. The name of that role stays English. The singer then opens /rehearsal/ on the choir site and signs in. Guest can open songs marked public, without an account.

### Which languages are available?

This website is in English, Estonian, Russian, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Swedish, and Finnish. In WordPress the plugin menus stay English: Choir Rehearsal, Pro License, Settings, and Add Song. The role names Singer, Voice Leader, Administrator, and Guest stay English. WordPress itself can use your language.

### Where are the recordings stored?

Songs, recordings, and scores stay on the choir’s own WordPress site. Compath OÜ does not host that library. The demo at demo.rehearsal.compath.ee is shared. Compath OÜ is at Ahtri 12, Tallinn, For help, write to support@compath.ee. Orders go to order@compath.ee, or call +372 55520482.

### How do Pro updates work?

From Pro 0.5.0, WordPress installs updates automatically (Dashboard → Updates or Plugins) while the license is active. You can also turn on auto-updates for the plugin. A Pro install older than 0.5.0 must be replaced once from your shop account, then the license is activated under Choir Rehearsal → Pro License.

### Do I still need Lite?

Yes. Keep Compath Choir Rehearsal (Lite) installed and activate Pro beside it. Do not replace Lite.

### What do the roles mean?

Singer listens. Voice Leader manages songs. Administrator also opens Settings. Guest sees public songs only. These role names stay in English in every language.

### What does Pro cost?

€49 per year for one choir website, from shop.compath.ee.

## Updates

- Lite: updates through WordPress.org like any directory plugin (Dashboard → Updates). GitHub Releases remain available as an alternative.
- Pro 0.5.0 and later: updates install automatically in WordPress (Dashboard → Updates or Plugins) while the license is active. You can enable auto-updates for the plugin.
- Pro older than 0.5.0: download 0.5.0 once from your shop.compath.ee account and replace the plugin, then activate the license under Choir Rehearsal → Pro License. After that, updates are automatic.
- Installed version: Choir Rehearsal → Settings.

Lite 0.4.63 updates from WordPress.org. Pro 0.5.0 updates automatically while the license is active. An older Pro plugin needs one manual replacement.
